name: Meesho

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — online test (MCQs + 2–3 coding), then interviews
rounds: Online assessment (about 90–150 min: MCQs plus 2–3 coding questions)
Technical interviews (DSA, OOP, DBMS, low-level design)

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Heavy — 1 medium + 1 hard style DSA, then machine coding and design
rounds: Round 1 (about 60 min): 2 DSA problems on HackerRank/HackerEarth
Round 2 (up to 2 hours): machine coding / low-level design (e.g. Facebook-feed APIs, snake-and-ladder variant)
Round 3: design + hiring manager (HLD overview, LLD deep dive on e.g. ratings & reviews, project architecture, behavioral)
extraTopics: HLD + LLD of a real system
